# santosh1808.singh@gmail.com (cid:131) +91-9771498978 + India § SantoshSingh-GitHub (cid:239) santoshSingh-Linkedin

Professional Summary

Seasoned Cloud & DevOps Professional with 13+ years of IT experience, including 6 years specializing in Azure Cloud Infrastructure, Automation, and CI/CD pipeline engineering. Expert in designing, implementing, and optimizing scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud solutions using Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Azure DevOps. Skilled in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, and DevSecOps practices for end-to-end automation and compliance. Proven track record of reducing deployment times by 40%, improving uptime and security posture, and driving cloud modernization and operational excellence. Passionate about mentoring teams, optimizing delivery pipelines, and building reliable, high-performance infrastructure in Agile environments.and driving cloud modernization and operational excellence. Passionate about mentoring teams, optimizing delivery pipelines, and building reliable, high-performance infrastructure in Agile environments.

Technical Skills Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure

Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, AzureDevOps (YAML)

CI/CD & GitOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Helm

Version Control: Git, GitHub, Azure Repos

Scripting & CLI: PowerShell, Bash, Azure CLI, Python (for automation)

Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes(AKS)

Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus & Grafana

Security & Access Management: Azure Key Vault, Defender, Sentinel, NSG, Firewall

DevSecOps & Compliance: Checkov, Trivy, TFSec, TFLint, SonarQube

Networking: DNS, VPN, Load Balancer, Private Endpoints, Ingress Controller, Network Policies

Project Management Tools: Azure Boards, JIRA

Work Experience KVG Agro Pvt. Ltd. — Noida, India Senior DevOps Engineer

Apr 2024 – Current

Automated Azure infrastructure provisioning using modular Terraform, achieving 100% configuration consistency and faster deployments.

Designed Azure Landing Zones with reusable Terraform templates ensuring security, compliance, and scalability across environments.

Built multi-stage CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps + GitHub Actions) improving release velocity by 40% and reducing manual interventions.

Deployed and managed microservices on AKS with node pool isolation, auto-scaling, and self-healing strategies for high availability.

Designed multi-tier architectures integrating Azure Front Door, API Management, and Application Gateway for global load balancing and API lifecycle management.

Optimized Azure spend through reserved instances, auto-scaling, and proactive cost management dashboards leveraging Azure Advisor insights.

Executed Lift & Shift migration assessments and data migrations using Azure Migrate and DMS to modernize legacy systems.

Managed full lifecycle Azure implementations under Agile frameworks with focus on risk mitigation and stakeholder communication.

Implemented GitOps with Argo CD and OCI-compliant images from Azure Container Registry (ACR) for declarative deployments.

Integrated security scanners (SonarQube, TFSec, TFLint, Trivy, Checkov) into pipelines, cutting misconfigurations by 50%.

• Established DevSecOps pipeline with image scanning, dependency validation, and secret rotation via Azure Key Vault. • Provided L3 support for Azure infra, Linux servers, and network connectivity (VPN, routing, proxy) ensuring system

uptime & compliance.

Ericsson India Pvt. Ltd. — Noida, U.P DevOps Engineer

July 2021 – Mar 2024

Developed multi-stage CI/CD pipelines using Azure Pipelines to standardize deployments across environments. • Managed Azure IaaS/PaaS components — VNets, App Services, Functions, and Storage Accounts — with governance via RBAC & Azure Policies.

Designed and implemented Hub-and-Spoke network topology with centralized shared services in the Hub VNet and segregated workloads in Spoke VNets, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant network communication.

Automated connectivity using VNet Peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Private Endpoints for hybrid workloads. • Implemented high availability & DR with Azure Front Door, Backup Vault, and Geo-replication for business continuity. • Enhanced observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, enabling proactive issue detection and performance tuning.

Implemented governance framework with standardized naming conventions, tagging, and cost-center mapping for compliance and manageability.

Configured budget alerts, resource tagging, and cost forecasting dashboards using Azure Cost Management for budget adherence.

Enhanced operational efficiency with Logic App workflows and Azure Automation runbooks for routine maintenance. • Collaborated with global dev and infra teams to align provisioning and deployment pipelines, improving release efficiency and system reliability.

Organized internal bootcamps and Azure capability uplift programs, contributing to organization’s Cloud Center of Excellence (CoE).

Reliance SMSL Ltd. — Patna, Bihar DevOps & Linux Systems Engineer

Mar 2018 – May 2020

Automated routine operations using Bash scripting and cron jobs, improving efficiency and reducing manual errors by 30%.

Managed Linux servers, web services (Apache/Nginx), and CI/CD with Jenkins and Git. • Handled Azure-based test environments for compute, storage, and security configuration. • Strengthened monitoring through custom alert scripts and native tools to maintain 99% system uptime. Dec 2010 – Feb 2018

Essjay Ericsson Pvt Ltd. — Patna, Bihar

System Administrator

Managed server provisioning, kernel patching, and system hardening for 350+ production systems. • Monitored RAN/OSS environments using ENM, Nagios, and Zabbix, improving fault detection time by 40%. • Supported core network services (DNS, DHCP, FTP, NTP) and collaborated with NOC teams for rapid issue resolution. • Maintained audit-ready documentation and uptime reports for SLA compliance.

Projects

Cloud-Native Monitoring & Control Platform for Dairy Industry

Deployed microservices on AKS using Docker, Terraform, and GitOps (Argo CD). • Built Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines enabling automated build, test, and release workflows. • Implemented observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor) and SLO-based alerting, reducing downtime by 35%. • Container images published via Azure Container Registry with integrated incident response automation.

Telecom Network Operations Automation (Singapore Telecom Client)

Automated RAN site health monitoring and KPI reporting for 300+ sites, saving 60% manual effort. • Integrated Ericsson ENM data with Azure Monitor and Grafana dashboards for unified observability. • Used Terraform for provisioning hybrid infra (VPN Gateway, Log Analytics, VMs). • Used Terraform to provision hybrid Azure infrastructure (VPN Gateway, Log Analytics, VMs) for real-time NE monitoring.

Implemented AKS-based alarm monitoring with Argo CD for continuous delivery and Azure RBAC + backup automation for SLA adherence.

Education Cambridge Institute of Technology, Ranchi B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering

Ranchi University Marks obtained: - 70%

DVC +2 Inter College Intermediate of Science

BIEC Patna Marks obtained: - 62%

High School Kumardhubi Matriculation

BSEB Patna Marks obtained: - 63%
